archivo-y-preservacion.title: Preserving knowledge is a form of freedom.
archivo-y-preservacion.introduction: Having access to something does not mean you own it. When you depend entirely on a platform, you also depend on its decisions, its permissions, and its permanence. Saving the files can mean important knowledge for the next generations.

sections.title: Access is not preservation
sections.body: We call lists, libraries, and collections “ours” when they actually live behind external services. A link can break, a video can disappear, and an account can become unavailable. For someone researching a topic, that fragility is not a detail: it affects the memory they can build and share.

sections.title: A library you can take with you
sections.body: Academia Blockchain lets you download the available files and preserve them outside the platform. The aim is that useful knowledge is not locked inside an intermediary.

sections.title: Preserve together
sections.body: If a piece of content only has an external link (URL) and you have the file, you can suggest it and upload it to Academia Blockchain. The community then relates sources, keeps materials, and strengthens shared research.

archivo-y-preservacion.takeaway: A community preserves what it values better when it does not depend on a single place to reach it. Download the files.

aprender-sin-algoritmos.title: Your curiosity should not obey a wall of recommendations.
aprender-sin-algoritmos.introduction: Social network algorithms optimize the time you spend looking, not the depth of what you learn. Academia Blockchain offers another way to discover knowledge.

sections.title: Your attention has a purpose
sections.body: An automatic recommendation decides what appears in front of you and what stays out. Its incentive is usually to keep you inside the platform, alternating stimuli and advertising, not to help you understand a complex subject.

sections.title: Convenience can also limit you
sections.body: When we constantly delegate discovery, we stop exercising curiosity. Content becomes more immediate and superficial, while there is less room to pause, compare, and think deeply.

sections.title: Explore with intention
sections.body: On Academia Blockchain you can follow topics built collaboratively and knowledge paths organized with a purpose. This is not about keeping scrolling. It is about choosing a question and moving toward your own understanding.

aprender-sin-algoritmos.takeaway: The platform offers routes to explore; the direction of your learning remains yours.

aceptamos-criptomonedas.title: Using cryptocurrency separates the economy from the State.
aceptamos-criptomonedas.introduction: On Academia Blockchain you can pay with cryptocurrency. Every time you use a State currency you hand over your energy and your time. Literally.

sections.title: Printing dilutes work
sections.body: We work and exchange that work for money. We spend it or we save it. The asset that makes exchange possible does not appear on its own: a central bank produces it. The more people demand it, the more value it gains. And the more value it has, the more notes can be 'printed' before anyone notices, that is, before the new issue shows up as inflation. Printing dilutes the value people had already given to the existing notes by exchanging their work for them. It is a quiet theft.

sections.title: Money could be worth more
sections.body: If there were no standing policy of creating money out of nothing, money would gain value. People could save, and prices would fall rather than rise: when money is worth more, things are worth less in terms of money. Universities nevertheless teach economists to fear deflation.

sections.title: Separating the economy from the State
sections.body: To use State money is also to pay taxes. It is better to hand over as few resources as possible to a power that does not represent you and whose corruption you know. Paying with cryptocurrency is an effort to leave an economy shackled by bureaucrats who do not understand what they are doing, but believe they can dictate the price of things. And the matter does not end with them. Those who set the interest rate and control the central bank create crises on purpose: To use cryptocurrency is to step out of their economy. It is to separate the economy from the State.

aceptamos-criptomonedas.takeaway: Every payment in state fiat currency is an implicit acceptance of a system of oppression and surveillance. Fortunately, there is a way out: use cryptocurrency.
